comment.comment:
75% $DAC, 25% $DCC for DacityCoin.

I went through all 80 GTA 5 stocks across both exchanges to figure out how Rockstar names their tickers.

Every single stock used a three-letter ticker, and the most common naming convention was literally just taking the first three letters of the company name.

Maze Bank → MAZ
Merryweather → MER
Sprunk → SPU
Vapid → VAP
Betta Pharmaceuticals → BET

Apply that exact same logic to DacityCoin:

DacityCoin → DAC

It’s literally the most common naming convention Rockstar has used historically. No overthinking, just the first three letters.

The only other ticker I see making sense is $DCC, which would be Da-City-Coin, following Rockstar’s history of using abbreviations.

But DacityCoin is written as one word, not three, which makes DAC the more natural choice.

I’m leaning 75% $DAC, 25% $DCC. Think like the Rockstar normies here 🫡
